lines.en: There’s nothing quite like a trip to the porn shop at the end of the night. Everyone knows why you’re there.

We’re the type who can’t sleep until we get our fill. The type who have hollowed out a special place in our hearts for sex and sexual paraphernalia.
And there is nothing too depraved for us.

: Please just ignore them. This overt and blatant promiscuity is little more than a means to get on my nerves.
: Sounds to me like somebody needs a new dick! And maybe a ring or two to dress it up with!
: We’ll get her to tone it down, Makoto. Learning is a process.
: Don’t you think she might be learning a little too quickly though?
: Sensei! Maki told me she’ll promote me to supervisor if I can sell a hundred dicks this week! You’ll help, right! I really need the cash.
: For what?

: Ooh, floating text!

: Have fun, you two! And don’t forget to do your homework!
: I really hope this isn’t going to happen every time I come here from now on.
: Makoto and I will still be here, don’t worry. I’m just letting Miku help out around the place so she can feel better about taking money from me.

: I...didn’t assume it did until you said that.
: Nothing at all!

: Oh, stop. I might be an aggressive salesperson, but I know better than to market dildos to depressingly hetero males like you. Gotta know your market.

: For now you are. But within moments, Sensei, you’ll be praising Maki Miyamura for her unbeatable eye and predatorial business acumen!

I notice immediately upon entry that some things have been shifted around. Which means that either she’s converting this room into something else or-

Yes, that is exactly why I am uncomfortable right now.
